name: Top 25 churches by attendance
description: Largest congregations by reported weekly worship attendance
query:
SELECT c.name, c.city, c.state, d.name AS district, c.attendance, c.baptized, c.communing
FROM churches c
LEFT JOIN districts d ON d.lookup_id = c.district_lookup_id
WHERE c.attendance IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY c.attendance DESC
LIMIT 25

name: Congregations per state
description: Count of churches and total baptized members by state
query:
SELECT state,
       COUNT(*) AS churches,
       SUM(CASE WHEN has_stats = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_stats,
       SUM(baptized) AS baptized_total,
       SUM(attendance) AS attendance_total
FROM churches
WHERE state IS NOT NULL AND state != ''
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY churches DESC

name: District roster
description: All districts with scraped congregation counts and synod metrics
query:
SELECT name,
       member_congregations,
       baptized_members,
       communicant_members,
       attendance,
       giving_millions,
       preschools + elementary_schools + high_schools AS schools
FROM districts
ORDER BY name

name: Synod summary (official vs scraped)
description: Compare official LCMS figures to locally scraped totals
query:
SELECT congregations_official,
       congregations_scraped,
       congregations_with_stats,
       baptized_members_official,
       baptized_members_scraped,
       communing_members_official,
       communing_members_scraped,
       avg_weekly_attendance_official,
       avg_weekly_attendance_scraped,
       total_giving_millions_official,
       total_giving_millions_scraped,
       updated_at
FROM synod_summary
WHERE id = 1

name: Last build / import metadata
description: When data was fetched and row counts from the last import
query:
SELECT fetched_at, source, church_count, stats_count, district_count, yearly_rows
FROM build_meta
WHERE id = 1

name: Churches missing stats
description: Congregations in the locator with no PDF stat profile
query:
SELECT c.name, c.city, c.state, d.name AS district, c.status
FROM churches c
LEFT JOIN districts d ON d.lookup_id = c.district_lookup_id
WHERE c.has_stats = 0
ORDER BY c.state, c.name
LIMIT 100

name: Churches without financials
description: Has stats flag but no row in church_financials
query:
SELECT c.lookup_id, c.name, c.city, c.state, c.last_stat_year
FROM churches c
LEFT JOIN church_financials f ON f.lookup_id = c.lookup_id
WHERE c.has_stats = 1 AND f.lookup_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.name
LIMIT 100

name: Churches missing contact info
description: No phone, email, or website on record
query:
SELECT name, city, state,
       phone, email, website
FROM churches
WHERE (phone IS NULL OR phone = '')
  AND (email IS NULL OR email = '')
  AND (website IS NULL OR website = '')
ORDER BY state, name
LIMIT 100

name: Yearly history coverage
description: How many year rows each church has in church_yearly
query:
SELECT CASE
         WHEN yr_count = 0 THEN '0 years'
         WHEN yr_count BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN '1-3 years'
         WHEN yr_count BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN '4-7 years'
         WHEN yr_count BETWEEN 8 AND 9 THEN '8-9 years'
         ELSE '10+ years'
       END AS coverage_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS churches
FROM (
  SELECT c.lookup_id, COUNT(y.year) AS yr_count
  FROM churches c
  LEFT JOIN church_yearly y ON y.lookup_id = c.lookup_id
  WHERE c.has_stats = 1
  GROUP BY c.lookup_id
)
GROUP BY coverage_bucket
ORDER BY coverage_bucket

name: National trends (all years)
description: Synod-wide yearly metrics used by dashboard charts
query:
SELECT year,
       congregations,
       sample_size,
       baptized_members,
       communing_members,
       avg_weekly_attendance,
       total_giving_millions,
       confirmations,
       infant_baptisms + adult_baptisms AS baptisms
FROM national_yearly
ORDER BY year

name: Top districts by giving
description: Districts ranked by reported giving (millions)
query:
SELECT name,
       giving_millions,
       attendance,
       baptized_members,
       communicant_members,
       member_congregations
FROM districts
WHERE giving_millions IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY giving_millions DESC

name: Avg giving per baptized member by district
description: Rough per-capita giving using district totals
query:
SELECT d.name,
       d.giving_millions,
       d.baptized_members,
       ROUND(d.giving_millions * 1000000.0 / NULLIF(d.baptized_members, 0), 2) AS dollars_per_baptized
FROM districts d
WHERE d.giving_millions IS NOT NULL AND d.baptized_members > 0
ORDER BY dollars_per_baptized DESC

name: Church size distribution
description: Bucket churches by weekly attendance
query:
SELECT CASE
         WHEN attendance IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
         WHEN attendance < 50 THEN 'Under 50'
         WHEN attendance < 100 THEN '50-99'
         WHEN attendance < 200 THEN '100-199'
         WHEN attendance < 500 THEN '200-499'
         ELSE '500+'
       END AS size_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS churches
FROM churches
GROUP BY size_bucket
ORDER BY MIN(COALESCE(attendance, -1))

name: Top givers (congregation financials)
description: Churches with highest reported contributions
query:
SELECT c.name, c.city, c.state, d.name AS district,
       f.report_year, f.contributions, f.contribs_per_confirmed_member
FROM church_financials f
JOIN churches c ON c.lookup_id = f.lookup_id
LEFT JOIN districts d ON d.lookup_id = c.district_lookup_id
WHERE f.contributions IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.contributions DESC
LIMIT 25

name: Churches with schools
description: Congregations linked to one or more schools
query:
SELECT c.name, c.city, c.state,
       COUNT(s.school_name) AS school_count,
       GROUP_CONCAT(s.school_name, ' | ') AS schools
FROM church_schools s
JOIN churches c ON c.lookup_id = s.lookup_id
GROUP BY c.lookup_id
ORDER BY school_count DESC, c.name
LIMIT 50

name: Ministry categories
description: Count of ministry listings by category
query:
SELECT COALESCE(category, '(none)') AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS ministry_listings,
       COUNT(DISTINCT lookup_id) AS churches
FROM church_ministries
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY ministry_listings DESC

name: Largest attendance drops (YoY)
description: Single-year attendance declines in church_yearly history
query:
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT lookup_id, year, attendance,
         LAG(attendance) OVER (PARTITION BY lookup_id ORDER BY year) AS prev
  FROM church_yearly
  WHERE attendance IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.name, c.city, c.state, y.year,
       y.prev AS prev_attendance, y.attendance,
       y.attendance - y.prev AS change
FROM yearly y
JOIN churches c ON c.lookup_id = y.lookup_id
WHERE y.prev IS NOT NULL AND y.attendance < y.prev
ORDER BY change ASC
LIMIT 25

name: Search churches in Texas
description: Example state filter — change TX to any state abbreviation
query:
SELECT name, city, state, attendance, baptized, communing
FROM churches
WHERE state = 'TX'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN attendance IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, attendance DESC
LIMIT 50

name: Church profile (join all core tables)
description: Full snapshot for one church — change the lookup_id
query:
SELECT c.lookup_id, c.name, c.city, c.state, c.status,
       d.name AS district, c.attendance, c.baptized, c.communing,
       f.report_year, f.contributions, f.child_baptisms,
       f.junior_confirmations, f.adult_confirmations
FROM churches c
LEFT JOIN districts d ON d.lookup_id = c.district_lookup_id
LEFT JOIN church_financials f ON f.lookup_id = c.lookup_id
WHERE c.lookup_id = 608180

name: Recent national membership change
description: Year-over-year delta for baptized, communing, and attendance
query:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT year, baptized_members, communing_members, avg_weekly_attendance,
         LAG(baptized_members) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS prev_baptized,
         LAG(communing_members) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS prev_communing,
         LAG(avg_weekly_attendance) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS prev_attendance
  FROM national_yearly
)
SELECT year,
       baptized_members - prev_baptized AS baptized_change,
       communing_members - prev_communing AS communing_change,
       avg_weekly_attendance - prev_attendance AS attendance_change
FROM ordered
WHERE prev_baptized IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY year DESC
LIMIT 15
